name: SignaturePad
description:
A handwritten signature as a form value. Draw with a mouse, pen or finger: strokes swell
and thin with speed and pen pressure, and are stored as points so the signature redraws
sharply at any size. "Type instead" takes a typed name for people who cannot draw.
Undo removes the last stroke and Clear empties the pad; with the pad focused, Delete
clears and Ctrl/Command+Z undoes. Export with `signatureToSvg` or `signatureToPng`.

A drawing on its own does not establish who signed: the application records who, when
and what was agreed.
signature: ({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, allowTyped, aspectRatio, readOnly, disabled, invalid, required, name, onBlur, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: SignaturePadProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: allowTyped
props.description: Offer "Type instead", so people who cannot draw can sign with their typed name. Default true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no Field label names the pad.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width ÷ height of the signing area. Default 3. The pad keeps this shape at every width.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Show the invalid state (set by SignatureField when its error shows).

props.name: name
props.description: Name for a native form submission (a hidden input carries the value as JSON).

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the pad, for form libraries' touched state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called after each stroke, undo, clear or typed change with the new signature (null when empty).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the signature without the toolbar; it cannot be changed.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: value
props.description: The signature, or null when empty. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.
